rci1_using_msad.detail: Multi-site; 3 independent datasets from different institutions: CNP (UCLA, discovery dataset), COBRE (validation dataset 1), DIRECT site 20 (First Affiliated Hospital of Chongqing Medical School, validation dataset 2). The normative model is trained on HCs from all three datasets.
rci1_using_msad.supporting_text: "A total of 496 patients with psychiatric disorders and 255 healthy controls (HCs) from three distinct datasets (one for discovery and two for validation) were enrolled. Individualized gray matter morphological abnormalities were determined using normative modeling"

rci2_using_epd.detail: COBRE (Center for Biomedical Research Excellence) is an EPD (8 uses in this review) and is one of the three datasets providing HC reference data for the normative model. CNP (OpenfMRI) and DIRECT are not in the EPD list.
rci2_using_epd.supporting_text: "Validation dataset 1 was obtained from the Center for Biomedical Research Excellence (COBRE), accessible at http://fcon_1000.projects.nitrc.org/indi/retro/cobre.html"

rci3_epd_name.detail: COBRE HCs (n=73 after exclusions per Table S1) are part of the normative reference cohort. CNP (UCLA Consortium for Neuropsychiatric Phenomics, via OpenfMRI) and DIRECT are not in the EPD list. Note: DIRECT site 20 is associated with the REST-meta-MDD project (per supplementary reference Chen et al. 2022), but the paper identifies this dataset as 'DIRECT' (not REST-meta-MDD) and uses only a single site (site 20) specifically to avoid multi-site effects; it is not counted as the REST-meta-MDD EPD here.
rci3_epd_name.supporting_text: "Validation dataset 1 was obtained from the Center for Biomedical Research Excellence (COBRE), accessible at http://fcon_1000.projects.nitrc.org/indi/retro/cobre.html"

rci5_n.detail: Computed from Table S1: CNP HC n=110 + COBRE HC n=73 + DIRECT HC n=251 = 434. Note: the abstract states 255 HCs from three datasets, which is arithmetically inconsistent with Table S1 values (DIRECT HC alone is 251). The Table S1 breakdown is used here as it provides detailed, internally consistent per-dataset counts. The abstract value (255) is likely a reporting error.
rci5_n.supporting_text: "HC (n = 110)" [CNP discovery]; "HC (n = 73)" [COBRE validation 1]; "HC (N=251)" [DIRECT validation 2]; abstract: "255 healthy controls (HCs) from three distinct datasets"
rci5_n.location: Fang2024_sup.docx.md: Table S1, L35; Fang2024.pdf.md: Abstract, L42

rci6_sex.detail: Computed from Table S1 sex percentages and Ns: CNP HC male 78.38% of n=110 → 86M / 24F; COBRE HC male 68.49% of n=73 → 50M / 23F; DIRECT HC male 34.66% of n=251 → 87M / 164F. Pooled: male n=223 (51.4%), female n=211 (48.6%). Female_n estimated as total N minus computed male_n within each dataset; minor rounding applied.

rci7_age.detail: Weighted mean computed from Table S1: (110×31.26 + 73×36.07 + 251×39.64) / 434 = 16021.35 / 434 = 36.92 years. Pooled SD computed as sqrt(((110-1)×8.66² + (73-1)×13.08² + (251-1)×15.87²) / (434-3)) = sqrt(83457.4 / 431) = 13.92 years. Age range (min/max) not reported for the normative HC sample. Age in years.
